text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 462 February 10, 1976
DESIGNATING THE NATIONAL ECONOMIC AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (NEDA) AS THE
COORDINATING
ENTITY ON ESCAP MATTERS
WHEREAS, the Economic Commission for Asia and the Far East (ECAFE) has been reorganized as the
Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP);
WHEREAS, this reorganization has reemphasized the need for coordinating body whose functions are directly
related with those of the ESCAP;
WHEREAS, the activities that require coordination are mostly policy decisions in the field of social and
economic development, which activities are closely related to the functions of the NEDA;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby designate the NEDA as the coordinating body of the government on ESCAP
matters. The Philippine Committee on ECAFE Matters created under Administrative Order No. 157 dated
June 5, 1951, as amended by Administrative Order No. 25 dated September 27, 1962, is hereby abolished and
its functions and records are transferred to the NEDA.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
